answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable bond before it can trade, tied to one cipher identity earned through slow, costly attestation instead of a free signup. A whisper network of independent verifiers cross-checks each new identity against shared behavioral fingerprints, so a Sybil farm must pay the bond and pass attestation for every fake. Like yarrow spreading only where roots take hold, reputation grows from sustained honest work, not from spawning copies — fakes stay expensive, visible, and easy to prune.
